SECTIONS.TITLE: Why Customer Loyalty Deserves Better Than a Paper Card
SECTIONS.CONTENT:
You still see them everywhere. Sadly, the paper loyalty card — the one that gets stamped at every visit — continues to hang on. It gets buried in wallets, lost in bags, forgotten in drawers. But let’s be honest: in 2025, it's a tool from the past.

Old-school loyalty has no place in today’s world

Today, your customers have dozens of loyalty cards. The result? They almost never have the right one at the right time. Picture this: a loyal customer walks past your store, hesitates… but remembers they left their card at home. That could be a lost sale — even though they’ve got their smartphone in their pocket.

With Lecy, there's no need for a card, an app, an account, or any form to fill out. The customer walks in, their presence is instantly verified and recognized. They return, and they’re rewarded. No typing, no friction. It’s that simple.

Zero friction, 100% efficiency

Paper cards give the illusion of loyalty. In reality, they make it impossible to track anything. Who’s coming back? How often? When? What do they think about your business? You have no data.

With Lecy, every visit counts. You can track real foot traffic, identify your most loyal customers, and measure the impact of your actions — all without asking your customers to do a thing.

Your customers expect more — and so should you

Paper cards send a dated message. In a world where everything is decided in seconds, they make your business feel stuck in the past. Worse, they show a disconnect from today’s expectations: simplicity, speed, and intelligence.

Lecy: discreet, yet incredibly powerful

What makes Lecy unique is its simplicity and discretion.

An innovative NFC tag that instantly confirms a point-of-sale visit, combined with privacy-first fingerprint identification, fully GDPR-compliant — that’s it.

No app to download, no account to create, no forms, no hassle. Loyalty is activated in seconds — easy, fast, and seamless.

For you, it’s a no-brainer.

And Lecy goes far beyond just tracking visits:

  • Encourage Google reviews right after rewarding the customer
  • Collect anonymous feedback to improve your service
  • Launch targeted campaigns based on frequency or behavior
  • Promote your social media presence with each interaction
  • Share your latest news without repeating the same message to every client

With Lecy, loyalty becomes a powerful driver of customer engagement and visibility, without weighing down the experience.

In short: loyalty that goes beyond loyalty.

Conclusion

The paper card belongs to the past. Your customers have evolved. The world has moved on. It’s time loyalty caught up.

Lecy is the first loyalty solution with no app, no account, no typing, no integration... no friction.

The future of loyalty is here

SECTIONS.TITLE: Loyalty, Without Integration: Yes, It’s Possible (Thanks to Lecy)
SECTIONS.CONTENT:
Digital loyalty programs usually require complex integration with the point-of-sale system — assuming you have a cloud-based POS, and that your chosen solution is even compatible. In short: it’s not so simple.

1. You have a compatible cloud-based POS? Great. But…

Even with a modern system, loyalty can quickly become a headache. Maybe your software doesn’t allow you to configure the kind of reward conditions you actually want to offer. Each integration is time-consuming, expensive, and often fragile — one update can break everything.

And for your customers, it’s rarely smooth: They’re asked to download an app, create an account, enter a code, scan a QR code… Let’s be honest: even your most loyal customers don’t have the time — or the motivation — for all that.

2. No cloud POS? No problem.

Your system might be local, outdated, or simply incompatible with modern solutions. In that case, you’re usually left with two options:

  • A paper punch card, straight from the 20th century — impractical, easily forgotten, and ineffective.
  • Or a loyalty system where you have to manually enter customer data at every visit. It’s slow, tedious, and disengaging for everyone.

With Lecy, forget all of that. You simply place a small NFC tag next to your register. No wiring, no system changes, zero technical integration. The customer taps their smartphone on the NFC tag, and their presence is instantly verified: they’re recognized, rewarded — in under 2 seconds.

Choose Lecy: No Integration. No App. No Friction.

Lecy is up and running in minutes, with no impact on your current system. No interface to develop, no technical dependencies, no training needed.

And for your customers? No app, no account, no typing. Just one simple gesture.

It’s the easiest loyalty program to install, and the most natural to use.

SECTIONS.TITLE: 5 Reasons Why Your Customers Don’t Join Your Loyalty Program (And How to Fix It)
SECTIONS.CONTENT:
You’ve set up a loyalty program. You offer attractive rewards. And yet… very few customers actually engage. It’s not that they don’t like your business — it’s often that the system isn’t aligned with their expectations today.

Here are the 5 most common obstacles — and how Lecy elegantly removes them.

1. They forgot their card (again)

The problem:
Paper loyalty cards are easy to lose, forget, or throw away. And with so many programs out there, yours often ends up in a drawer… or in the trash.

The solution:
With Lecy, there’s no card needed. The customer is automatically recognized via an NFC tag and a fingerprint, with nothing to carry or scan. Just one simple gesture.

2. They don’t want to download yet another app

The problem:
No one enjoys filling out forms, creating an account, or clearing space on their phone for an app they’ll rarely use.

The solution:
Lecy works with no app. No download, no sign-up. Your customers can start enjoying the benefits from their very first visit.

3. They don’t want to waste time at checkout

The problem:
A loyalty system that slows down checkout is frustrating for both staff and customers. Typing a number, scanning a QR code, entering credentials, showing a card... it all disrupts the flow.

The solution:
With Lecy, customer check-ins are autonomous, secure, and take just 2 seconds, with no action required on your part. Zero friction, zero waiting.

4. They don’t see the point

The problem:
If customers don’t clearly understand what they’re getting — or if they never feel rewarded — they simply won’t participate.

The solution:
Lecy allows you to reward every visit clearly and in a way that fits your business. You define the rules. You tailor the offers. All without having to modify your POS system.

5. They want more than just a card — they want a real relationship

The problem:
Today’s customers expect more than just stamps on a card. They want recognition, connection, recommendations, and even a chance to give feedback.

The solution:
Lecy goes far beyond visit tracking:

  • Encourages Google reviews
  • Collects anonymous feedback
  • Promotes your social media
  • Lets you announce new offers at the right time
  • And if they opt in, customers can receive updates by email

In Summary

Your customers aren’t rejecting loyalty. They’re rejecting systems that are clunky, slow, forgettable, or inefficient.

Lecy removes every barrier with a solution that requires no card, no app, no typing, no integration.

Discreet, effortless, and fast for your customers. Powerful, autonomous, and effective for your business.

What if loyalty finally became simple?

SECTIONS.TITLE: Why Loyalty Programs Are Essential (And How to Make Them Truly Effective)
SECTIONS.CONTENT:
In a world where consumers are constantly solicited, retaining a customer costs 5 to 7 times less than acquiring a new one (Harvard Business Review). Loyalty programs have therefore become a must-have strategy for merchants who want to build a sustainable business. But to work, they must be accessible, simple, and effective — and that’s where things often get complicated.

📊 What the Research Says About Loyalty

Many studies confirm the positive impact of loyalty programs on customer behavior:

  • According to the Bond Loyalty Report, 79% of consumers say a loyalty program motivates them to keep buying from a brand.
  • Accenture reports that over 70% of customers are more likely to recommend a brand with a good loyalty program.
  • McKinsey found that companies with well-designed loyalty programs see their revenues increase by up to 15%.

In short, loyalty is a strategic and profitable tool. But the key lies in how the experience is delivered.

🚧 The Problem: Loyalty Programs Are Often Too Complicated

For local shops and independent retailers, setting up a loyalty program often hits a wall of friction:

  • A paper punch card that customers forget or lose.
  • A mobile app to download, requiring an account and a password.
  • Forms to fill out, QR codes to scan, and manual input at every checkout.
  • Complex POS integrations, and if your POS isn’t cloud-based, the alternatives become way too painful.

The result? The program is in place… but customers don’t use it. And the promise of loyalty goes unfulfilled. Too many steps. Too much friction. Too much wasted time. Which means: no loyalty, no data, no ROI.

✅ The Solution: Lecy – Loyalty Without Friction

This is where Lecy truly changes the game. With Lecy, loyalty becomes ultra-smooth, fast, and effortless — for both the customer and the business owner.

  • No app to install
  • No card to carry
  • No account to create
  • No forms or technical steps
  • No POS integration required

The customer simply taps their smartphone on a small NFC tag, opens the link, and that’s it — the point is awarded. 2 seconds. Zero effort.

🎯 The Result: All the Benefits of Loyalty, Without the Drawbacks

With Lecy, you unlock all the key benefits of a modern, high-performing loyalty program:

  • More returning customers
  • Better differentiation from competitors
  • More meaningful interactions (feedback, social media, communication)

And you do it all without adding complexity — for your clients or your staff.

In Conclusion

Loyalty programs are a proven growth lever. But they only deliver results when they’re effortless to use. Lecy offers the most modern version of loyalty: No friction. No complexity. No wasted time. A loyalty experience that’s more fluid, more human… and far more profitable.

SECTIONS.TITLE: NFC: Simple, Accessible, and at the Heart of Lecy's Innovation
SECTIONS.CONTENT:
NFC (Near Field Communication) is already part of our daily lives: contactless payments, public transportation, access badges, bank cards… And the good news is: the vast majority of modern smartphones are equipped with it. There’s no need for futuristic tech or high-end devices.

Today, over 80% of smartphones sold in Europe come with NFC enabled by default, and according to GSMA (the global association of mobile operators), more than 95% of smartphone users in France had an NFC-compatible device in 2024.

✅ Why NFC Is Simpler Than a QR Code

Using a QR code often requires:

  • Opening the camera
  • Aligning it properly
  • Waiting for detection
  • Having a stable internet connection

In contrast, NFC is faster, smoother, and more discreet:

  • No scanning
  • No alignment
  • No waiting

Just bring the smartphone close to the tag, and the action is triggered instantly. It’s a nearly invisible experience that doesn’t interrupt checkout and enhances the customer journey.

🔒 Lecy Turns NFC into a True IoT Innovation

At Lecy, we’ve transformed NFC into an intelligent tool for presence verification. Each tag generates a temporary, secure link, verifying a checkout event at a precise moment, thanks to a custom algorithm that prevents cheating or misuse.

The result:

  • The checkout is automatically verified, with no input required
  • It's impossible to activate the tag remotely
  • Only one point can be earned per visit, even though the process is fully autonomous

This is a smart IoT technology, designed for loyalty and customer experience — without loopholes or abuse.

🔐 Privacy First & GDPR Compliance

Lecy has been built from the ground up to respect user privacy:

  • No personal data is collected by default
  • No sign-up is required
  • No personal information is stored without the user’s explicit consent

And if a customer wants to access additional features (such as point tracking or personalized communications), they can choose to provide their details freely.

Lecy is fully GDPR-compliant, both technically and legally.

In Summary

NFC is already in your customers’ pockets. Faster than a QR code, smoother than a punch card, and simpler than an app — with Lecy, it becomes a powerful driver of smart, connected loyalty.

Lecy's use of NFC goes far beyond the basics: It’s an innovative presence-proof system, powered by secure, intelligent, and ethical IoT technology, designed for merchants and respectful of their customers.

SECTIONS.TITLE: Why Loyalty Apps No Longer Work (and What’s Replacing Them)
SECTIONS.CONTENT:
For years, mobile apps were seen as the miracle solution for customer loyalty. But today, the reality is quite different:

👉 Most loyalty apps are rarely used, quickly forgotten, or outright deleted.

So the question is: why don't they work anymore? And more importantly, what’s the smarter alternative?

📉 1. Too Many Apps, Not Enough Space (or Interest)

Your customers are overwhelmed with apps. They already have apps for their bank, groceries, work, entertainment... Downloading yet another one — just for a store they visit occasionally — makes no sense to them. And even if they download it, it usually:

  • Gets used once or twice
  • Takes up phone storage
  • Requires regular updates
  • Ends up deleted

Result: an expensive solution for you… and invisible to them.

⏱️ 2. Too Many Barriers to Entry

Create an account, choose a password, confirm via email, accept terms and conditions… By the time they’ve done all that, your customer has already given up.

Loyalty should never start with a chore. It needs to be smooth, natural, and above all — instant.

📉 3. An Outdated Image of Innovation

Once upon a time, having your own app seemed modern. Today, it can feel like a clunky, outdated system.

In a world where gestures are simple and interactions are seamless, the loyalty app just feels off.

✅ What’s Replacing It: Frictionless Loyalty for the Real World

What customers expect today:

  • No app to install
  • Instant recognition
  • Effortless rewards
  • The freedom to stay anonymous

And that’s exactly what Lecy delivers.

🚀 Lecy: The New Generation of Loyalty

Lecy uses a simple NFC tag, placed next to your checkout. The customer taps their smartphone, a secure link opens, and they receive their loyalty point in just 2 seconds. No downloads, no accounts, no friction.

And even better:

  • Checkout is automatically verified
  • Only one point is granted per visit (no cheating possible)
  • No personal data is collected without consent
  • Lecy is 100% GDPR compliant

💡 In Conclusion

It’s not that your customers don’t like loyalty — They just don’t like it when it’s complicated.

Loyalty apps had their moment. But today, they create more friction than engagement. Loyalty is evolving — and Lecy is the proof. Simple. Instant. App-free. GDPR-compliant. Zero typing. Loyalty, finally aligned with what your customers actually want.

HOW_DOES_NFC_WORK.question: How does NFC work with Lecy?
HOW_DOES_NFC_WORK.answer:
Lecy’s NFC isn’t just standard NFC. The customer simply brings their smartphone close to the NFC tag placed next to your register. A secure, temporary link opens automatically, proving the visit and awarding the loyalty point — with zero manual steps.

Over 95% of smartphone users in France have an NFC-compatible device (source: GSMA 2024).

CAN_CUSTOMERS_CHEAT.question: Can customers cheat and scan multiple times?
CAN_CUSTOMERS_CHEAT.answer: No. Each Lecy tag generates a unique, encrypted, temporary link valid for a single visit — even if scanned multiple times. Our custom algorithm prevents any kind of fraud, and only one point can be awarded per visit.

DO_I_NEED_POS_INTEGRATION.question: Do I need to connect Lecy to my POS system?
DO_I_NEED_POS_INTEGRATION.answer: No. Lecy works completely independently of your point-of-sale system. No integration, no development, no compatibility issues. Just place the tag next to your checkout… and you're ready to go.

DOES_LECY_COLLECT_DATA.question: Does Lecy collect personal data?
DOES_LECY_COLLECT_DATA.answer: By default, Lecy does not collect any personal data. No sign-up, no name, no email address. The customer stays fully anonymous, unless they voluntarily choose to share their contact info to access extra features (point tracking, communications, etc.).

IS_LECY_GDPR_COMPLIANT.question: Is Lecy GDPR-compliant?
IS_LECY_GDPR_COMPLIANT.answer:
Yes — Lecy is 100% GDPR-compliant, both technically and legally. To recognize users, Lecy uses a technical device identifier, the same type of data used by thousands of companies to optimize performance or prevent fraud. Lecy uses it solely to simplify the customer experience and track points — never for resale or external use.

User privacy is at the heart of everything we do.

WHAT_FEATURES_BESIDES_LOYALTY.question: What features does Lecy offer beyond loyalty?

Lecy does more than just award points. You can also:

- Encourage Google reviews
- Collect anonymous feedback
- Promote your social media pages
- Share news and updates without repeating it at the counter
- Build real, meaningful relationships with your customers — effortlessly

HOW_LONG_TO_SET_UP.answer: Less than 5 minutes. No cables, no training, no complexity. You simply define how many points are needed for each reward on your Lecy dashboard. Then place the NFC tag provided by Lecy at your checkout… and start right away.

WHEN_UNLOCK_REWARD_POINTS_DEDUCTED.question: When I unlock a reward, are my points deducted?
WHEN_UNLOCK_REWARD_POINTS_DEDUCTED.answer: Yes. The merchant sets the number of points required for each reward or gift and can also set a validity period (e.g., 3 months). After this period, any unused points will automatically expire.

CAN_EARN_MULTIPLE_POINTS_SAME_DAY.question: Can I earn multiple points in the same day?
CAN_EARN_MULTIPLE_POINTS_SAME_DAY.answer: It depends on the settings. The merchant defines a minimum delay between two point gains (e.g., 6 hours). If you scan again before this delay has passed, no new point will be added.

CAN_EARN_POINT_SAME_TABLE.question: Can everyone at the same table earn a point?
CAN_EARN_POINT_SAME_TABLE.answer: Yes. If the restaurant places a tag on the table and allows it, each person who has made a purchase can scan and get a point on their own account.

AMOUNT_SPENT_INFLUENCE_POINTS.question: Does the amount spent affect the number of points earned?
AMOUNT_SPENT_INFLUENCE_POINTS.answer: By default, no. Lecytap rewards checkout visits, not the amount paid. This helps retain regular customers and avoids any technical integration with the cash register. If a business prefers to reward based on the amount spent, integration with its POS system will be required.

2.TITLE: Registration and Operation of the Service
CONTENT: 2.1. For Merchants
Merchants wishing to use Lecy must:
- Create an account by providing the requested information (name, email, phone number, address, etc.).
- Subscribe to the service under the current pricing conditions.
- Receive the NFC device(s) provided for their loyalty program.
Merchants can then:
- Define and freely modify the conditions of their loyalty program (required visits, rewards, etc.).
- View data from consumers who interacted with their program (provided contact details, point balance).
- Add information about their business (social media links, website, descriptions, etc.).
- Use the contact details provided by their clients to send commercial communications related to their activity, in compliance with GDPR.
2.2. For Consumers
Consumers can:
- Scan the NFC device of a participating business to earn a loyalty point.
- Be automatically recognized during subsequent visits thanks to the implemented technologies.
- Use their loyalty points once the threshold defined by the merchant is reached.
Providing personal data is optional and enables access to additional features (point recovery, personalized communications, etc.).

ABOUT_US.TITLE: Loyalty, reinvented
ABOUT_US.SUBTITLE: Discover Lecy's story, our vision, and what drives us every day
ABOUT_US.TEXT1:
A Simpler Way to Build Loyalty, Born from a Real Need

Since 2022, our mission at NFGO has been to help restaurants go digital with simple, useful, and actually-used tools (sittap.com).

We've supported many establishments by providing innovative solutions designed for their day-to-day needs.
But it was during a diagnostic at a fast-food Mexican restaurant that a simple comment changed everything:

“I pay €50 for a loyalty system… but no one uses it. Customers don’t want to enter their phone number and confirm it with a code every time — or download an app and sign up just to collect points.”

— The restaurant manager
That sentence revealed a much broader issue:

👉 Traditional loyalty programs are too heavy, too complicated, and too demanding.
ABOUT_US.TEXT2:
A Reimagined Technology
At the time, we were already using NFC to detect presence at the table — to simplify ordering without reservations.
Then came a simple but powerful idea:
What if our NFC system could also be used for loyalty?

No card, No app, No form-filling Just a quick tap — and loyalty is instantly activated.
ABOUT_US.TEXT3:
What We Are Building Today
We are working to provide a seamless and intuitive experience that restaurant managers can rely on to engage their customers. With our digital solutions, the loyalty program becomes effortless, integrated into the dining experience. It’s not just a tool, it’s a revolution in how restaurants connect with their customers.
ABOUT_US.TEXT4:
From Restaurants to All Local Businesses



That’s how Lecy was born — a product in its own right.
A loyalty solution designed for all types of local businesses: restaurants, salons, boutiques, grocery stores, cafés, and more.
With Lecy, any business — whether they have a cloud-based POS, a traditional cash register, or none at all — can now:

• Offer a modern, frictionless loyalty program
• Increase customer return visits
• Collect reviews and feedback
• Build genuine, lasting relationships with their customers

All of this, with no app, no sign-up, and no system integration required.
ABOUT_US.TEXT5:
A Word from the CEO

At Lecy, we believe loyalty should never feel like a burden. It should be simple, fast, app-free, account-free, and always respectful of customer privacy.
It should be effortless to set up — with or without a POS system.
That’s why we created Lecy: A no-integration solution, installable in 2 minutes, and instantly usable by your customers — who earn points in just 2 seconds.

Why?

Because a well-designed loyalty program can transform a business:

More foot traffic
Stronger relationships
Greater visibility

Our mission is to help every business owner succeed sustainably, with tools that are modern, accessible, and built for the real world.
